expectations.live: Fresh nonempty title, focused button and explicit unsupported Text interface on button; erased false; explicit cleared title after close
expectations.unfocused: Changing focus once to another control produces focused false; held observation cannot restore it or pass
expectations.short-stop: A bounded read succeeds after the 50 ms stop with the unchanged nonempty title
expectations.long-stop: Stopped owner retains X focus but cannot provide observations; text, state and erasure cannot pass within 200 ms; after 350 ms resume the original title remains
expectations.dead: Previously read title cannot become empty/erased and focus cannot pass after owned process exits; require an explicit service failure
expectations.removed: The live owner explicitly reports a nonexistent object; only this response plus a fresh accessible live owner may satisfy removed-object erasure
expectations.denied: An independent private D-Bus calibration service returns AccessDenied; this cannot satisfy text, focus or erased predicates
